description: Claude Code only, and the sole registration of `hook session-start` / `hook post-tool-use` (#534). No other host mounts a hooks bridge, so no other host writes the plugin's tool-call log: there `enchiridion tool-call-stats` has nothing to read and `enchiridion ingest` prints no post-commit cost summary (its documented silent behaviour with no log), while DSH's own session log under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` carries the `tool/call` / `tool/result` records. Session capture rides the same bridge: this hook is what records the transcript path `/save-conversation` reads, so a host with no hooks bridge has no plugin-visible transcript to save (ADR-0026). Records this session's transcript_path at start so /save-conversation can find it reliably (#23), and logs every tool call so `enchiridion tool-call-stats` can report the cost of a run (#100). Both fail open (#153): `|| exit 0` keeps a hook handler error — or, pre-#254, a failed binary bootstrap — from interrupting the session, at the cost of that hook's side effect for this run. Since #254, bin/enchiridion is a thin `exec node <bundle>` shim with no fetch step, so there is no retry-storm risk left for PostToolUse (firing on every tool call) to guard against; it no longer sets ENCHIRIDION_NO_FETCH, which is now meaningless to the shim.
